Name: Minecart for Cute Valley
Author: BeneathThePlass
Description:
I'm a huge fan of [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/members/rosalie.518048/]Rosalie[/url]'s Cute Valley retexture mod of the farm, as well as the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11881]Integrated Minecarts - A Minecart Expansion[/url] mod, which adds a minecart to your farm (amongst other things!). After awhile though, I realized that I wanted the minecart on my farm to match the rest of my farm, so- I made this mod! It's just a simple recolor of the minecart to match the Cute Valley aesthetic. It comes in white, pink, blue, and purple, to match the varying colors available for Cute Valley! If you'd like your minecart to match your farm, just choose your color, download, and install! Note: this will retexture ALL the minecarts in game, not just the one on your farm if you have Integrated Minecarts!


[b]Installation: [/b]
[b]1. [/b]Make sure that you have both [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] correctly installed in your Stardew Valley folder.
[b]2. [/b]Download the Minecart for Cute Valley color of your choice, white, pink, purple, or blue.
[b]3. [/b]Unzip the '[CP] Minecart for Cute Valley' folder and drop it into your 'Mods' folder in the main SDV game folder.
[b]4. [/b]Congrats, you're done and ready to go! Enjoy your new minecart!


[b]Credits:[/b]
[list]
[*]Credit to [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/members/rosalie.518048/]Rosalie [/url]﻿on the Chucklefish forums, as they created the original [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/content-patcher-cute-valley-1-3-beta.110882/]Cute Valley mod[/url]﻿ and provided inspiration for this retexture!
[/list]
